name: catching fish from the bottom of a river
source:
Trapped in a mahjong match, two girls must find a way to win – if they don't tear each other apart first.

[From [url=https://midnight-hour.itch.io/catching-fish-from-the-bottom-of-a-river]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
被困在一场麻将牌局中的两名少女必须设法赢下比赛——前提是她们没有先一步把对方撕成碎片。

[摘自[url=https://midnight-hour.itch.io/catching-fish-from-the-bottom-of-a-river]itch.io[/url]]
